svg.title: Full quartic SU(2) Yang–Mills action and its variation
svg.desc: The exact displayed density is (a L) squared times (b L) squared divided by two. Both coordinate axes have zero curvature and action. The slice a L equals b L equals one plus s retains its constant, linear, quadratic, cubic and quartic terms. Original action factors hbar and g Yang–Mills are shown in the display map. See F7.51 through F7.53.
